An unnamed '''Sith Entity''' was kept [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in stasis as a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] onboard the [[Emperor's Fortress]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]], [[Darth Malgus]] took control of the space station and proclaimed himself the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of a [[New Empire]]. A strike team was dispatched to take Malgus down and encountered the Entity on their way to the throne room. After being released from the containment, the Entity attacked the group, but was defeated, after which it returned to its incorporeal state. The strike team then proceeded to attack Malgus, which resulted in the destruction of the entire space station.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Entity appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss during "The False Emperor" flashpoint.
